name: Long Ridge Campground
evidence: Official site map: sites 12-19 back the creek on the south edge; CampLife 'Backs up to creek' 11-19, lengths 24-38 ft. Satellite: unit row with woods behind, creek under canopy and absent from NHD, so unmeasured. Pond ~36 m: 22-25 not legible; east lot 32-64 m off.

name: Old Salem Public Recreation Area
evidence: GP Lakes per-site coords on satellite: Waterfront-tagged 66, 68, 70, 75, 89, 87 ~17-24 m from Lake Oconee (RV visible at 66); engine site photos show lake right behind those pads, no road between. Lengths 28-50 ft.

name: Moccasin Creek State Park
evidence: Satellite + RA GIS: site 17 ~65 m from Lake Burton across park road and open day-use lawn, a view not access; site photos don't face the lake. Sites 02-05 tagged near water, NHD Moccasin Creek ~15-25 m off, but creek absent from site photos and under canopy: creekside not earned.

name: Oconee Springs Park
evidence: Official park map PDF: Beach Side 1-20 and Lake Side 21-41 none on shore; day-use beach, marina, cabins, event center and parking between. Satellite: lake-side pads ~30+ m from cove behind road/parking; open view holds at some sites (19-20, 27-28).

name: Red Top Mountain State Park
evidence: RA GIS on satellite: tagged RV sites 28-33, 51 ~45-80 m from Allatoona's high-water edge (34, 35 are 20 ft, don't count). DEM 292 m at pads vs 265 m on water, a bluff with railings on photos of 29, 30, 33. Site photos show lake through open woods at 31-33, 51.

name: Rocky Mountain Recreation Area
evidence: GoOutdoorsGA per-site coords on satellite: Waterfront-tagged 34, 35 ~25 m, 33 ~29 m (canopy overhang hides true shore, so closer). Agency site photos: 26, 28, 32, 34-37 pad and open woods with Antioch Lake right behind. Lengths 41-50 ft. Swim beach is separate, NE corner.

name: Savannah South KOA Holiday
evidence: Official KOA site map: RV sites 9-14, 62 in a row on the 35-acre lake with only lawn/path. Satellite: decks at the waterline with pads behind, ~0-25 m; pine belt applies only to inner loops. Booking: back-in on the lake with private deck, quoted for 23-ft motorhome.

name: Stay Wilder Campground
evidence: Official park map: 8 'Water & Electric Creek' sites 13-16, 24, 27-29 at woods edge by Crawfish Creek; Campspot to 40 ft. Satellite + NHD: creek channel with glints at treeline, ~18-30 m from units (NHD line approximate; site numbers not tied to units). Pond ~42 m wide also near, site 9 ~23 m.
